title: HINGE CHOIR
description: Sixty-four hinged levers form a coupled mechanical instrument. Pulling one hinge stores angular energy that propagates through neighbours; damping, coupling and phase bias move the system between isolated knocks, travelling responses and collective motion.

visual_finish.composition: an eight-by-eight field of mechanical levers reads as one instrument while local impulses produce travelling energy bands
visual_finish.material_model: brushed dark linkages with brass pivots, restrained orange stress accents and soft mechanical shadows
